arithmetic: For every split-color overflow witness with a valid smaller-block square terminal, deduplicate (p,R,source,E) and enumerate the complete odd-distance even-source Type I lift family from the strictly smaller even source.
scope_note: Finite targeted lift audit only. It covers 253 witness states and their 506 deterministic cross-color assignments. A miss does not rule out another source, distance, target divisor, or lift family; the F state that generated a square terminal may still lack its target divisor.
